body:
New web/recorder.mjs (MediaRecorder tapped off the exact worklet output already reaching the speakers) and web/iduna.mjs (popup-based IDUNA SSO sign-in + sso-exchange + upload). Download live-verified in real headless Chromium (record -> stop -> real non-empty Blob). Save-to-IDUNA code-complete and IDUNA-side verified, but not yet live end-to-end on mixforge.okemily.com: confirmed via a real Playwright run against production that the popup/registration/token-return flow all work, and that the one remaining gap is a same-origin nginx /api/ proxy to IDUNA that needs root to deploy (queued: sudo-queue/96-mixforge-api-proxy-nginx.sh, not yet run). MIXFORGE@079fac8.

⚓ ☃
